name: visual
description: One image used as a design element (builder library, 2026-11): a photo cut to a circle, blob, pill or rounded frame, or transparent art (pandas, orbs, icons) as it is. Optional glow, shadow or ring, a size step, alignment, caption and link. Animations come from the block's ap-anim-* class, not from here.

image.description: Image URL (Media Library or kit asset).

alt.description: Alt text. Empty for pure decoration; the kit's alt pass then labels it from its surroundings and hides it from screen readers.

shape.description: Frame. `none` keeps transparent art uncut; circle, blob and pill crop the image (cover).

size.description: Width step: 64, 120, 200, 320, 480px, or the full width of its column.

fit.description: How the image fills a cropped frame.

effect.description: Soft drop shadow, coloured glow, white ring, or the indigo-to-teal gradient ring.
